source_info.dataset: Additive Walgreens OTC product and inventory research
source_info.source_method: Products, online prices, and inventory counts were read manually from visible Walgreens product pages and the Check other stores inventory drawer. No automated scraping was used.
source_info.inventory_note: Counts are point-in-time quantities shown by Walgreens in the visible store inventory drawer. The seven requested NJ stores are represented for every product. fexofenadine at Willow Ave was explicitly shown Out of stock with the in-stock filter disabled. Other entries were shown with positive counts.
source_info.price_note: Prices are Walgreens online product-page prices at check time. They may vary in store and may change; displayed promotional offers are not included in the base price.
